name: Calendly
prompt: Build a scheduling app where an owner defines weekly availability, meeting durations, buffers, and blackout dates. Guests choose a timezone-aware slot and receive an .ics invite. Prevent double-booking transactionally in SQLite, add reschedule/cancel links, and provide a minimal admin calendar.
notes: Single-calendar scheduling is approachable. Reliable two-way sync across providers is the cliff.
